description: This file defines a Java interface for a service that provides dropdown options related to share products, specifically lock-in period frequency types and minimum active period frequency types, as part of the 'shareproducts' module in the Fineract project.

classes.name: ShareProductDropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods to retrieve dropdown options related to share product configurations.

methods.name: retrieveLockinPeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns available options for lock-in period frequency type, as a collection of EnumOptionData.

methods.name: retrieveMinimumActivePeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns available options for minimum active period frequency type, as a collection of EnumOptionData.
